title: jnprofile-python
text: jnprofile-python is the Python profile of jnterfaces. A profile sets up a project in one language. It has tools, for example lint, and each tool brings its packages, its parts of the config files and its recipes. A recipe is a command of the project’s Justfile, such as just lint. The profile is for a Python project with uv. The installer finds such a project by its pyproject.toml or uv.lock.

title: jnprofile-python
text: Run this command in a project that has the jnterfaces installer: just install --profile python The command installs the tools lint and test. It also turns on the default roles of the profile, tasker and prose, unless you choose otherwise. The roles in the jnterfaces guide tells what each role installs. In a folder with no pyproject.toml, it first runs uv init --bare --no-workspace. Then add or remove a tool: just install typecheck just uninstall lint The machine needs just and uv. uv runs Python and the tools. To install Python and every dependency into .venv, run just setup.

title: jnprofile-python
text: Tool Packages Recipes lint ruff, pre-commit just fmt, just lint, just hook test pytest, pytest-cov just test, just cov typecheck ty just typecheck The tools gives each recipe and each part that a tool adds to a config file.

title: jnprofile-python
text: A part is the piece of a shared config file that a tool owns. just install adds the part, and just uninstall takes out only that part. Your own settings stay. ruff.toml gets an include. The installer writes the settings of the profile to .agents/config/python/ruff.toml, and adds extend = ".agents/config/python/ruff.toml" to your ruff.toml. A setting in your ruff.toml wins over the setting of the profile. pyproject.toml gets the unit tool.uv.default-groups = "all". So uv sync and uv run install the dependency groups of every tool. ty.toml and .pre-commit-config.yaml get units. A unit is one key or one item of a list. Each unit has a comment on the line before it, which names its owner. .gitignore and .worktreedisposable get a block of lines. A block starts and ends with a comment that names its owner. Do not edit a file under .agents/config/. Only the installer writes it. Shared files and the record in the jnterfaces guide tells you how the installer keeps a record of each part.

title: jnprofile-python
text: jnterfaces: the installer, and the just, jagt-protocol and cx skills. jnprofile-typescript: the TypeScript profile. agent_gest_git_skills: the tasker role and its g skills.

title: The tools
text: Each tool of the profile brings its packages, its recipes and its parts. The installer adds the packages to a dependency group of pyproject.toml with uv add. The profile sets tool.uv.default-groups = "all", so uv sync and uv run install every group.

title: The tools
text: Each project of the profile gets the base, with no tool. Recipe What it does just setup Installs Python and every dependency into .venv, as uv.lock says The base adds .venv/, .local/, __pycache__/, *.pyc, dist/ and build/ to .gitignore. It adds .venv/, __pycache__/ and *.pyc to .worktreedisposable, the list of files that a command makes again, so that they do not keep a worktree.

title: The tools
text: The packages are ruff and pre-commit, in the group lint. Recipe What it does just fmt Formats the code. Extra arguments go to ruff: just fmt --check just lint Checks the code against the rules of ruff. Extra arguments go to ruff: just lint --fix just hook Installs the git hook, which runs the checks of .pre-commit-config.yaml before every commit. Run it once for each clone The parts: ruff.toml: an include of .agents/config/python/ruff.toml. That file sets line-length = 120, leaves out .agents, .claude and .codex, and selects the rules E, W and F. When your pyproject.toml has a [tool.ruff] table, the installer adds no part to ruff.toml, because ruff reads ruff.toml in place of the settings in pyproject.toml. .pre-commit-config.yaml: one item of repos for each repository of checks. The checks are the checks of any file from pre-commit-hooks, then ruff, the linter and then the formatter. The tool adds .ruff_cache/ to .gitignore and to .worktreedisposable. just uninstall lint also takes out the git hook that just hook installed.

title: The tools
text: The packages are pytest and pytest-cov, in the group test. Recipe What it does just test Runs the tests. Extra arguments go to pytest: just test tests/unit. A project with no tests yet passes just cov Runs the tests, and shows the lines that they ran The tool adds .pytest_cache/, .coverage and htmlcov/ to .gitignore and to .worktreedisposable.

title: The tools
text: The package is ty, in the group lint. Recipe What it does just typecheck Checks the types. Extra arguments go to ty: just typecheck src The part is a unit of ty.toml, the key exclude in the table [src]. It leaves out .agents, .claude and .codex. When your pyproject.toml has a [tool.ty] table, the installer adds no part to ty.toml, for the same reason.
